name: Alconera (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over white with a blue triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alconera (a tower and stars on blue, a bordure of yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Alconera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
